field_meaning.hi: मरुमक्कथयम परिवार का वरिष्ठ पुरुष प्रबंधक

review_objections: Alibaba: Marumakkathayam is a matrilineal system (Nairs of Kerala), not a general 'Hindu succession' topic in the standard sense; also, Karnavan is the eldest male, but the topic classification is misleading as it is a specific custom, not a general statutory term like Karta.
